description: This file is a Lua script implementing a ball collision simulation with interactive elements, including classes, setup, and rendering functions.

classes.name: Ball
classes.description: Represents a ball object with position, velocity, collision detection, movement, and drawing routines.

methods.name: Ball:init
methods.description: Constructor to initialize a Ball instance with position, velocity, and color properties.

methods.name: Ball:collision
methods.description: Handles collision detection between this ball and others, as well as interactions with the mouse.

methods.name: Ball:move
methods.description: Updates the ball's position based on its velocity and handles boundary collisions.

methods.name: Ball:draw
methods.description: Draws the ball on the screen.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the simulation environment and creates balls.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Main rendering loop that updates and renders the scene each frame.
